name: Afghan Bolani with Potato Filling
description: Thin flour pockets filled with peppery potato and green onion, then shallow-fried until crisp.

instructions: Mix the flour with salt and enough water to form a stiff dough, then knead it until smooth.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest for at least thirty minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes, then season them with green onions and black pepper.
Roll the dough very thinly, cut rounds, and seal a small amount of filling inside each one.
Shallow-fry the bolani on both sides until crisp and browned, then serve them warm.
